list.title: Autonomous agents
list.subtitle: Agents watch the feedback in their scope and, when a trigger fires, run a workflow: research, personas, PR/FAQ, PRD and a prototype, reviewed by personas before handing off a project.
list.createHint: It is created disabled with its own editable copy of the “Reviews → Prototype” workflow. Configure triggers and the workflow, then enable it.
list.emptyAdmin: Create one to turn new feedback into researched projects and prototypes automatically.
list.emptyUser: An administrator hasn't set up any agent you can see yet.
list.spend: {{runs, number}} scheduled runs today · {{calls, number}} model calls this month
list.spendHint: Manual runs are not counted against the daily scheduled-run limit.
list.deleteMessage: “{{name}}” stops running and leaves your agents. Its past runs and the projects and documents it made are kept. A run in progress finishes first.

library.title: Workflow library
library.subtitle: Every workflow agents can run. Archive the ones you no longer need: they leave the library and become read-only, and their revisions are kept.
library.loadFailed: The workflow library couldn't be loaded.
library.archiveMessage: “{{name}}” will be hidden from the library and the workflow picker and become read-only. Its revisions are kept.
library.archiveInUse: An active agent still runs this workflow. Archive that agent or give it another workflow first.
library.createHint: It starts as Start → End. Add steps in the editor, then pick it on an agent.
library.renameConflict: Someone changed this workflow meanwhile, or it is the built-in one. Reload and try again.

fields.name: Name
fields.instructionsHint: Guidance the agent follows in every step (up to {{n, number}} characters).
fields.visibility: Visibility of the projects it hands off
fields.visibilityHint: Private projects are visible to their owner, members and administrators only.
fields.workflowHint: Edit the steps on the Workflow tab.

detail.toggleFailed: The agent couldn't be enabled or disabled.
detail.archiveMessage: It stops running and disappears from the list. Projects it created stay.
detail.notFound: This agent doesn't exist or you can't see it.
detail.stats: {{runs, number}} runs in total · {{today, number}} scheduled today · {{calls, number}} model calls this month

triggers.hint: What wakes the agent. It runs at most twice a day on its own and never twice at the same time.
triggers.none: No triggers — it only runs when someone presses Run now.
triggers.cronHint: Five fields, e.g. 0 9 * * 1 for Mondays at 09:00.

kindHints.new_reviews: Runs when enough new feedback arrived in its scope since the last run.
kindHints.threshold: Runs when a category or subcategory reaches a number of reviews within a window.

personas.none: No fixed personas — the agent picks them from the project.
personas.allowGenerate: Allow the agent to generate new personas when none fit

models.hint: Choose the AI model for each part of the agent's work. Leave the default to follow Administration → AI models.

roleHint.orchestrator: Decides the next step and verifies each result.
roleHint.persona: Speaks for each persona in reviews.

budget.runsPerDayHint: At most 2. Manual runs are not counted.
budget.monthlyCapHint: The agent stops starting runs once the month's calls reach this cap.

run.hint: Each run follows the workflow. The graph lights up the steps as they run; it is a view, not a control.
run.alreadyRunning: A run is already in progress.
run.confirmMessage: The agent runs its workflow now. It calls the AI models (up to {{calls, number}} calls) and can take several minutes. You can cancel it from this tab.

summary.title: What happened

started.threshold: Started because a threshold was crossed.

startedAt.new_reviews: Started on {{when}} because new reviews arrived.
startedAt.threshold: Started on {{when}} because a threshold was crossed.

summary.needsDecision: Decide what happens next in the card above.

run.noGraph: The workflow of this run couldn't be loaded.
run.olderRevision: This run used revision {{n}} of the workflow.

editor.paletteHint: Drag a step onto the canvas, or press Enter to add it.
editor.nothingSelected: Select a step, an arrow or a loop — on the canvas or in the outline below — to configure it.
editor.loopFrameLabel: Loop {{n}}: until {{until}}, at most {{rounds, number}} rounds
editor.conditionHint: The arrow runs when the step reports this result; "Always" is the default path.
editor.noConditions: This step reports no verdict, so its arrows always run.
editor.noArrowsOut: No arrows leave this step yet.
editor.noArrowTargets: Every other step is already connected from here.
editor.maxRoundsHint: A whole number from {{min, number}} to {{max, number}}; at the limit the run stops and asks a human.
editor.joinLoopHint: A loop repeats its steps until its exit condition is met.
editor.leaveLoop: Take this step out of the loop
editor.emptyCanvas: The canvas is empty: add steps from the palette.
editor.clearMessage: Every step, arrow and loop is removed from the draft so you can build the workflow from scratch. Nothing is saved until you save.
editor.builtin: Built-in template — save a copy to change it.

history.title: Revision history
history.loadFailed: This revision could not be loaded.
history.unreadable: This revision’s workflow could not be read.
history.restoreHint: Loads this revision into the editor as unsaved changes. Save to keep it as a new revision.
history.confirmMessage: Revision {{revision}} replaces the workflow in the editor, and your unsaved changes are lost.

editor.resetMessage: Your unsaved changes are replaced by the built-in “Reviews → Prototype” workflow.
editor.conflict: Someone saved a newer revision meanwhile.

outcome.conflict: Someone saved a newer revision meanwhile.
outcome.invalid: The server rejected the workflow — fix the issues and save again.
outcome.import_failed: That file is not a valid workflow.

issues.instructionsRequired: This step needs instructions: say what it should do.
issues.duplicateStep: Two steps share the same id. Delete one of them and add it again.
issues.duplicateArrow: Two arrows share the same id. Delete one of them and draw it again.
issues.endStatus: Choose how the run ends here.

params.generateAvatars: Create a portrait for each persona
params.maxWordsHint: The whole document stays within about this many words. Empty: about 1,200 when the instructions ask for short documents, otherwise no limit.
params.useWebSearchHint: Counts toward the run's limit of {{limit, number}} web searches.

editor.savedAsAgent: Saved as “{{name}}”. This agent now runs it.
editor.savedAsSwitchFailed: The copy was saved, but this agent couldn't be switched to it. Pick it in the agent's settings.
editor.switchMessage: Your unsaved changes to {{name}} will be lost.
editor.switchFailed: The agent couldn't be switched to that workflow.

workflowPage.title: Workflow
workflowPage.subtitle: A workflow from the library. Agents that run it use its newest saved revision.

loopUntilHint.persona_agreement: Repeats while the persona review in the loop answers "Not agreed".
loopUntilHint.review_pass: Repeats while a review step in the loop answers "Fail".

aggregate_reviews.label: Aggregate reviews
aggregate_reviews.description: Collects the new feedback in the agent's scope and finds the main themes.

select_or_create_project.label: Select or create project
select_or_create_project.description: Reuses a project with the same purpose, or creates a new one.

select_personas.label: Select personas
select_personas.description: Picks the personas that matter for these reviews.

generate_personas.label: Generate personas
generate_personas.description: Creates new personas from the feedback when none fit.

deep_research.label: Deep research
deep_research.description: Runs a research job on the project, optionally with web search.

write_prfaq.label: Write PR/FAQ
write_prfaq.description: Drafts a press release and FAQ for the idea.

revise_document.label: Revise document
revise_document.description: Rewrites a document from the review's objections.

duplicate_document.label: Duplicate document
duplicate_document.description: Copies a document into another project.

persona_review.label: Persona review
persona_review.description: Personas score the work; agreement = average 4+ and nothing blocking.

final_review.label: Final review
final_review.description: A reviewer checks the whole package before hand-off.

custom_llm.label: Custom step
custom_llm.description: A step driven by your own instructions.

build_prototype.label: Build prototype
build_prototype.description: Builds an HTML prototype using the design system.

collect_prototype_feedback.label: Collect tester pins
collect_prototype_feedback.description: Reads the open pins testers dropped on the prototype, for the next revision.

revise_prototype.label: Revise prototype
revise_prototype.description: Changes the prototype from the review's objections.

handoff.label: Hand off
handoff.description: Gives the project to the owner of its main category.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Multi-step requests you approved in the AI assistant. They run in the background; open one to follow its steps, approve a step that asks, or cancel it.
plans.empty: No plans yet. Ask the AI assistant for something with several steps, and approve the plan it proposes.
plans.removeMessage: “{{goal}}” will be removed from your plans. Its results stay in your projects.
plans.removeFailed: The plan couldn’t be deleted. A plan that is still running must be cancelled first.

validation.scope: Choose at least one category or subcategory, or watch all categories.
validation.name: Give the agent a name of up to {{max, number}} characters.
validation.description: The description can be up to {{max, number}} characters.
validation.instructions: The instructions can be up to {{max, number}} characters.
validation.triggers: Check the triggers: each needs whole numbers in range, and a custom schedule needs its cron expression.
validation.personas: Choose at most {{max, number}} fixed personas.
validation.models: Choose an available model for each role, or the default.
validation.budget: Check the budget: the limits must be whole numbers in range.
validation.other: Some settings are not valid. Check them and try again.

decision.title: This run needs your decision

reason.loop_exhausted: The personas did not agree on the {{node}} after {{rounds, number}} rounds.
reason.no_fail_path: {{node}} did not pass and the workflow has no path for that.
reason.end_node: The workflow sends this run to a person at {{node}}.
reason.budget: The run used its model-call budget.
reason.verification: A step's result could not be verified.
reason.unknown: The run stopped for a person to decide.

decision.stopMessage: The run ends as completed and what it produced stays in the project. This cannot be undone.
decision.conflict: This run was already decided or is no longer waiting for a decision.

decided.accept: {{by}} chose to accept and continue at {{at}}.
decided.stop: {{by}} chose to close the run at {{at}}.

decision.banner: The last run of this agent needs your decision.

form.question: What should happen next?
form.pickObjections: Objections to fix (a blocking persona’s are ticked)
form.instructionsPlaceholder: For example: commit to paying hotels and meals when the wait is over 12 hours.

fix.label: Revise once more, fixing the objections I pick
fix.help: The document is revised with your picks and notes, then the personas review it again. If they still disagree, the run asks you again.
fix.incomplete: Pick at least one objection or write an instruction.

accept.label: Accept it as it is and continue
accept.help: The workflow carries on after “{{node}}” as if the personas had agreed. Their objections are not fixed.

other.label: Something else: tell the agent what to do
other.help: Your instructions go to the next revision, then the personas review it again.
other.incomplete: Write what the agent should do.

stop.label: Close the run
stop.help: Nothing more runs. What the run produced stays in the project.
